articles.summary: Program advances Jackson’s growth and diversification strategy, increases access to annuities Jackson National Life Insurance Company ® (Jackson®), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc. i (NYSE: JXN), today announced a new annuity program – AARP® Annuity Program from Jackson, an exclusive offering created for AARP members. Through the program, AARP members will have access to a distinct set of Jackson annuities and educational resources designed to help support financial security and retirement confidence. The initial launch of the program is expected on November 16, 2026, in 10 states, with broader availability targeted during the first half of 2027. The program advances Jackson’s growth and diversification strategy and expands consumer access to annuities. “This program reflects Jackson’s continued focus on growth, diversification and meeting consumers where they are in their retirement planning process,” said Alison Reed, EVP, Head of Distribution, Jackson
articles.title: Jackson Announces New Annuity Offering for AARP Members

articles.summary: Jackson Financial Inc. 1 (Jackson®) announced its Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.90 per share of common stock (NYSE: JXN) for the fourth quarter of 2026. The dividend on the common stock will be payable on December 17, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 3, 2026. The Company also announced the declaration of a cash dividend of $0.50 per depositary share (NYSE: JXN PR A), each representing a 1/1,000th interest in a share of Fixed-Rate Reset Noncumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series A. The dividend will be payable on December 30, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 3, 2026. In addition, Jackson’s Board has authorized an increase of $1 billion to the Company’s existing common share repurchase authorization, which adds to the remaining authorization of approximately $353 million as of September 30, 2026. Repurchases under the authorization may be made through open market purchases, unsolicited
articles.title: Jackson Announces Fourth Quarter 2026 Common and Preferred Stock Dividends and $1 Billion Increase to Common Share Repurchase Authorization
